messages.content: Write exactly 7 paragraphs—no more, no less. (Make paragraph breaks clear.) Separate paragraphs using this exact line on its own: "=====". Separate paragraphs with a visible divider line. The final line of your response must be exactly: "So overall, I'm good.". None of these may appear in the response: ['people', 'friction'].

How are you doing today? Finish with "So overall, I'm fine." and don’t add anything after it. Use exactly 7 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.) Do not use any of these words or phrases: ['people', 'friction']. Put a clear separator line between paragraphs. Use this exact divider line between paragraphs: "=====".
